Completing your project study or IDP at our chair

We are interested to supervise project studies and interdisciplinary procects (IDP) with a strong focus on data science and econometrics. These projects should be completed in a team of 2-4 students.

If you want to offer a project at your company, get in touch with us (see contact info). Attached to your mail, please send us a short description of your project idea and your company (as PDF, roughly one page). Please note that we have a limited capacity and cannot guarantee a supervision.

To apply for a project study or IDP as a student, please always attach your CV and transcript of record (in one PDF). You can find a list of open project study topics below on this page.
